sentence: This project studies how influenza A virus hemagglutinin changes shape and how this differs between avian and human adapted types.
This project builds a passive immunotherapy, a cocktail of long-lasting neutralizing antibodies, for people exposed to measles.
This project studies the neural basis of sensory hyperarousal and statistical learning in youth with Fragile X Syndrome, using a double-blind auditory entrainment study.
This project studies how glucagon-like peptide 1 signaling shapes olfactory sensory representations and behavior, and how diet-induced obesity disturbs this.
This project studies the role of the subacromial bursa in rotator cuff healing, aiming to improve treatment after rotator cuff repair.
This project studies how to block lipoprotein synthesis in Helicobacter pylori to help treat infection with it.
This project studies how a regulator controls Wnt signaling and intestinal stem cell function.
This project studies tuberculosis and other infectious diseases in human populations using bioinformatics.
This project sets up a mass spectrometer for high throughput proteomics research on heart disease, infectious disease and cancer treatment.
This project builds rehabilitation technologies for older adults, such as robots, wearable assessment systems and balance assessment tools.
This project builds tools to sense bioavailable metals in blood-based fluids and studies how metals help peptide hormones move and signal.
This project studies how genetic regulatory programs control active and facultative stem cells that renew epithelial tissues after injury.
This project offers advanced microscopy and imaging technologies, including electron microscopy, for studying cell and tissue morphology and ultrastructure.
This project offers confocal microscopy, flow cytometry and small animal imaging to support cancer research.
This project builds AI ultrasound tools to improve the diagnosis and management of twin pregnancy.
This project studies how a fast heart rate, called tachycardia, causes metabolic remodeling and cardiac dysfunction, using stem cell biology and tissue engineering.
This project tests a smartphone camera tool that measures joint range of motion and joint swelling in rheumatoid arthritis during telehealth visits.
This project brings together work on molecular imaging technologies for the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease.
This project looks for non-pathogenic oral Streptococcus species that lower cancer cell survival and change the tumor immune microenvironment in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
This project studies how cancer cells and endothelial cells affect each other when small cell lung cancer spreads to the liver.
